title: networking-fun lab manifest
description: Schema for .platform/manifest.yaml. Validates the lab/scenario/ttl/notes declared by a PR. Since Amendment A1 the only lab is the container lab (hello-fargate); the retired VPC labs fail validation loudly rather than silently provisioning nothing. The per-lab scenario whitelist is enforced by .github/scripts/validate-manifest.py; the union is captured here and the script narrows it.

scenario.description: Fault scenario for the chosen lab. Each lab accepts a subset of these (enforced by the validator script).

ttl.description: Time-to-live duration (e.g. 30m, 2h). Capped at 4h by the validator; default 4h.

notes.description: Free-text note rendered in the PR comment.
